objective: Wall-parity test of the reentrant section with periodic chains: PBC L16 (walls in pairs, like OBC L17) vs PBC L17 (forced odd number of walls, like OBC L16), on the OBC L16/L17 grid, with saved C=Cstag so the frozen OBC topology rules can be applied unchanged.
solver: exact diagonalization, eigsh k=2 (tol 1e-10), warm start along Gamma0; Gamma0=0 exact on the diagonal
correlators: raw, not connected; Czz of the two lowest states stored
matrix_saved: C=Cstag with circular phase (-1)^min(|i-j|, L-|i-j|) as key C (and Cstag) in seeds/scan_sXXXX.npz
state_save_policy: ground states (float32, all Gamma0) only for seeds passing the frozen physical selection; ED is deterministic and any other seed can be recomputed

h_map.note: same seeds at every h (paired); never pooled with the main cohort

seed_ranges_checked_unused_for_pbc: PBC seeds used before: 0-299 (ED review), 0-59 (DMRG), 1000-1049, 1100-1399 (ED), 2000-3499 (DMRG selected screen)

measured_cost_seconds_per_seed.note: one seed, h=2.5, single thread, idle machine (2026-10-23); L17 measured with tol 1e-11, expected ~15 % less

queue_design.restart: an abrupt shutdown leaves seeds as running, never failed; requeue the same command, completed seeds are skipped
